# Implementation Plan: Sistema de Controle de Protestos e Repasse de Pagamentos

**Branch**: `001-controle-protestos` | **Date**: 2026-06-30 | **Spec**: `specs/001-controle-protestos/spec.md`

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-controle-protestos/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan follows the GitHub Spec Kit structure generated by `.specify/scripts/powershell/setup-plan.ps1`.

## Summary

Build a simple administrative web site for internal protest tracking. The core flow is: funcionário imports protests, marks client payment, informs boleto, chefe sees pending boletos, marks boleto as paid, and the system updates dashboard and history.

The implementation uses a React/TypeScript front-end, Node.js/Express/TypeScript REST API, Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL on Supabase. A demo mode exists in the front-end so the site can be presented visually before production services are configured.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: TypeScript, Node.js 20+, React 18

**Primary Dependencies**: Express, Prisma, JWT, Bcrypt, Multer, Zod, Vite, React Router, Axios

**Storage**: PostgreSQL via Supabase, accessed through Prisma ORM

**Testing**: TypeScript build checks, manual acceptance testing for the main academic flow

**Target Platform**: Web browser for front-end, Node.js server for back-end

**Project Type**: Web application with separate front-end and back-end

**Performance Goals**: Dashboard and list views should load quickly for academic/demo datasets; no large-scale enterprise load is required.

**Constraints**: Keep scope simple; do not implement full cartório/legal workflow; do not invent legal rules; keep unknown rules as **(A DEFINIR)**.

**Scale/Scope**: Small academic/internal control system with 7 main screens and focused REST endpoints.
